title: Repentance
blurb: Turning back, and asking to be forgiven

items.title: Asking to be turned back
items.ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَىَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.tr: Rabbighfir li wa tub ʿalayya, innaka antat-Tawwabur-Rahim.
items.en: My Lord, forgive me and turn to me in mercy. Indeed You are the Ever-Returning, the Merciful.
items.benefits: Ibn ʿUmar said they would count him ﷺ saying this a hundred times in one sitting.

items.title: The words of Adam ﷺ
items.ar: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمۡنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمۡ تَغۡفِرۡ لَنَا وَتَرۡحَمۡنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ
items.tr: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin.
items.en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

items.title: The call from the darknesses
items.ar: لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
items.tr: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
items.en: There is no god but You. Glory be to You. Indeed I was among the wrongdoers.
items.notes: The words of Yunus ﷺ from inside the whale.
